$comment: The one place the org's runtime versions live (decision 0018 in tivtav-documentation). Bump 'latest' when AWS Lambda makes a new runtime generally available: repositories behind it get a warning. Raise 'minimum' once they have moved: repositories behind it then fail CI.

upcoming.note: Lambda public preview since 2026-08, GA targeted for 2026-11. Preview runtimes have no SLA: not for production until GA, then bump 'latest' here.

exempt.$comment: Lambdas that aws-cdk-lib creates for itself. Their runtime and architecture are set by CDK, not by us; they run only at deploy time. Matched against the CloudFormation logical id (regex) or the aws:cdk:path metadata (regex).
